notes: Round 0 evaluates random initial weights on validation data.
Subsequent round_metrics are VALIDATION metrics, not final-test metrics.
Final test is evaluated ONLY if evaluate_final_test is enabled.
Aggregation weights are normalized across participating clients per round.
Clients are simulated sequentially; model-transfer bytes are theoretical
uncompressed payload counts, not real network traffic or satellite latency.
The local optimizer is Adam, reset for each client in every round.
